region_scene_page.compact: A smooth late-1970s/early-1980s studio-pop road of jazz chords, R&B-schooled vocals, elite session playing, and immaculate adult-radio polish.
region_scene_page.standard: Yacht rock is a later name for a very specific smooth studio sound. Steely Dan, Michael McDonald-era Doobie Brothers, Christopher Cross, Toto, Kenny Loggins, and related artists make rock feel sleek, harmonically expensive, and rhythmically relaxed. The groove is clean, the chords are richer than standard soft rock, and the musicianship is almost invisible because it is so controlled.
